Thanks for the call this morning — good overview. A few follow-ups from our security team so we can progress procurement: 

- SOC 2 status: can you share current attestation (Type I/II) or timeline if in progress?
- Audit logs: we need details on admin activity logs and API request logs (fields captured, retention, structured format).
- Exportability: can logs be exported to a customer-controlled S3 bucket or BigQuery? Any APIs or scheduled exports?
- Immutability: are logs tamper-evident/append-only? Do you support immutability/WORM or signed checksums?

I've attached our standard security questionnaire (Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — we'd like to kick off the vendor questionnaire process.

Next steps from our side: security will review any doc you send and then schedule a deep-dive with our engineering team. Can you confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire and a rough ETA for responses?

—Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Appreciate you sending the questionnaire. High level next steps on our side:

1) I'll kick off the SQA and own coordination (timeline: initial responses inside 3 business days).
2) I'll attach a one-page audit-logging overview for your security team (redwood-audit-logging-overview.pdf) and link our SOC 2 status below.
3) Neha (security) + Aditya (product infra) — could you please provide the log field/retention/export details below and confirm immutability options?

Quick answers up front so you have something to work with ASAP:
- SOC 2: Type II in progress; our last Type I was completed in Q4 2025. Expected Type II completion: Q2 2026.
- Audit logs: We emit admin activity logs (user, timestamp, action, resource, IP, request_id) and API request logs (request/response metadata, latency, model used, token counts). Logs are structured JSON by default.
- Export: We support scheduled exports to customer S3 buckets and can stream logs to BigQuery / Splunk via connectors.
- Immutability: We support write-once append-only storage for logs and can ship signed checksums. For high-assurance workflows we can replicate logs to a customer-controlled bucket with object versioning enabled.

Attachments: redwood-audit-logging-overview.pdf (attached).
Link: SOC 2 status: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-audit-overview

I'll follow up once Neha/Aditya post the detailed responses to the questionnaire items. Happy to schedule the deep-dive next week if that helps.

Best,

Hi all — putting answers below and attaching our SQA responses (redwood-sqa-responses.pdf). Happy to expand any item.

1) Log fields (canonical)
- Admin activity logs: {"timestamp": "2026-03-12T08:34:00Z", "actor": "user:marissa_cole@redwood.com", "action": "role.change", "resource": "project:acme-prod", "ip": "203.0.113.24", "request_id": "req_abc123", "details": {"previous": "viewer", "new": "admin"}}
- API request logs: {"timestamp": "2026-03-12T08:34:00Z", "request_id": "req_def456", "client_id": "acme-client-1", "model": "redwood-v1.2", "prompt_tokens": 42, "completion_tokens": 128, "latency_ms": 210, "status": "200"}

Notes: logs are emitted as structured JSON; fields are searchable in Console and available via the Logs API.

2) Retention
- Default retention: 90 days for API logs, 365 days for admin activity logs.
- Configurable retention: customers can configure retention from 30 days up to 7 years (policy and legal hold support available on Dedicated/Private plans).
- Enforcement: retention enforced via automated lifecycle policies in our object store and DB layer; legal holds override retention windows.

3) Export options
- Scheduled exports: we support daily/hourly exports to customer S3 buckets (AES-256 encrypted in transit and at rest). Configuration: customer provides an IAM role + bucket ARN; we write only to that bucket.
- Streaming/Connectors: Pub/Sub/BigQuery streaming is available via partner connectors; Splunk/Datadog forwarders supported.
- API: Logs API supports programmatic pulls with pagination and time-range filters. Sample S3 config: see attached sample_export_config.json (we'll provide the JSON snippet in the SQA PDF).
- Security: For customer-directed exports we can write directly to the customer-controlled bucket and optionally disable any intermediate storage on shared infra.

4) Immutability/tamper-evidence
- Append-only model: Logs are written append-only; log objects are immutable once written.
- Object versioning & WORM: For Dedicated/Private customers we can enable bucket-level WORM/retention-lock and object versioning.
- Signed checksums: We support generating SHA256 checksums for export batches and maintain an audit manifest. We can also publish periodic Merkle-root summaries for high-assurance verification.
- External verification: We can push logs to a customer-controlled bucket (with versioning) so customers can independently verify integrity.

5) SOC 2 & compliance
- SOC 2: Type II audit is in progress; expected completion Q2 2026. Type I report (Q4 2025) is available on request.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support data residency and BAA agreements on Private deployments.

Attachments: redwood-sqa-responses.pdf (answers + sample configs).

If you want, I can join the deep-dive with your engineers next week — propose Thu 3/18 10am PT.

—Neha
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
